description: One of America's most revered artists, Georgia O'Keeffe loved New Mexico, writing: "It's so
beautiful there. It's ridiculous." This course follows O'Keeffe's path through Santa Fe, Taos, and
Ghost Ranch, engaging with her life and work within the Modernist movement and arts of the region.
Emphasizing New Mexico's rich Indigenous and Hispanic arts and culture and its unique natural
environment, the course uses feminist, decolonial, and critical landscape theories to analyze
O'Keeffe and her legacy. Offered alternate years during January term. There are no prerequisites,
fullname: O'Keeffe and Arts of New Mexico (study away)
shortname: O'Keeffe and Arts of New Mexico
